g.text: SWE-bench rig — end to end: every operation, its inputs, its outputs
DATASET ROW (one instance) — frozen at dataset creation 2024; HF revision unpinned
SWEBENCH PACKAGE — lives against whatever version is installed (now locked: 4.1.0)
INSTANCE IMAGE — frozen bytes (Docker Hub :latest tag; pinned locally by digest in image-digests.txt)
SPEC BUILD — inside EVERY eval invocation

text.tspan: The late-bound part: the requirements URN = repo + environment_setup_commit (frozen, dataset) + path (floating, package version). Assembled per invocation; content never stored on our side.

With prebuilt digest-pinned images, EVAL genuinely needs only: image + patch + eval script. The red dashed fetch feeds a script that never runs — it is the only network touch and the only unfrozen input in the marking path.

g.text: base_commit: <sha> — code state the agent patches
version: '3.2' — KEY into swebench package tables
version table: repo+'3.2' → python ver, install cmd, test cmd

text.tspan: ← URN assembled at USE TIME: repo+commit from dataset, path from package
the tables of THE SWEBENCH VERSION USED THAT DAY
OUT: instance image = snapshot + environment, materialised
IN: instance image + problem_statement — nothing else
IN: dataset row + package tables + LIVE FETCH of requirements
OUT: env-build script (NEVER RUN with prebuilt images)
repo-setup script (NEVER RUN with prebuilt images)
eval script (RUN: checkout tests @ base_commit, apply test_patch, run test cmd)
IN: pristine container from instance image + patch + eval script
OUT: report table (resolve rate, cost per resolved)
